updates.content:
Title: Users may not be able to open support central in Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender portals

User impact: Users may not be able to open support central in Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender portals.

More info: Users are able to open support tickets through the Microsoft 365 admin center to circumvent impact.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with two different Microsoft 365 portals and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may not be able to open support central in Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender portals

User impact: Users may not be able to open support central in Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender portals.

More info: Users are able to open support tickets through the Microsoft 365 admin center to circumvent impact.

Current status: We determined that a recent service update intended to refresh the pages of service central contained a code issue, which is resulting in impact. We've developed a fix to address this issue and will provide a remediation timeline once this fix is ready to deploy to all affected environments.

Scope of impact: This event impacts any user attempting to access support central through the Microsoft Intune or Microsoft Defender portals. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent service update intended to refresh the pages of service central contained a code issue, which is resulting in impact.

Next update by: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC
